name: Vanndar Stormpike
summary: At Dun Baldar, Vanndar Stormpike leads the Stormpike Expedition into Alterac Valley. He searches its frozen peaks for ancient relics and raw resources, waging an unyielding Alliance war against the Frostwolf orcs.

sections.title: Lord of Dun Baldar
sections.body: Vanndar Stormpike leads the dwarven excavation into Alterac Valley as a veteran mountain king of Ironforge. After the Third War, he marched the Stormpike Guard into the northern mountains to seek hidden mineral riches and long-lost titan artifacts. He made Dun Baldar his fortified base, claiming the valley as ancestral ground and rightful Alliance territory. From there, he directs military outposts, defensive bunkers, and frontline pushes. Vanndar is determined that no retreat will ever be sounded under his watch.

sections.title: War for the Frozen Pass
sections.body: Vanndar's mining and prospecting reached into the Frostwolf clan's home, starting a brutal mountain war. The orcs demanded that he withdraw, but he refused to yield an inch, vowing Alterac Valley would belong to the dwarves. From his throne room deep within Dun Baldar, with marshals and bodyguards at his side, Vanndar oversees the defense against Frostwolf incursions. He also sends Alliance champions to break enemy lines and claim the valley.

faq.answer: Vanndar Stormpike commands the Stormpike Expedition as a dwarf mountain king. From Dun Baldar, he leads the Alliance war effort in Alterac Valley.

faq.q: Why is Vanndar fighting in Alterac Valley?
faq.answer: Vanndar brought the Stormpike Expedition to Alterac Valley to seek ancient relics and extract natural resources. His refusal to abandon those claims drew the dwarves into bloody conflict with the native Frostwolf orcs.
Vanndar commands his forces from Dun Baldar, the northern stronghold in Alterac Valley. Dwarven bunkers, marshals, and elite guards protect it.
Vanndar's main enemy is Drek'Thar, chieftain and elder shaman of the Frostwolf clan. Drek'Thar seeks to drive the dwarven interlopers from the Frostwolves' ancestral homeland.

angles.text: As a dwarf of Ironforge, you can see Vanndar's indomitable Mountain King spirit in his fight to claim ancient heritage and honor the Explorer's Guild.
As an Alliance member, you can look to Vanndar as the leading commander on the Alterac front. He holds the northern ramparts and pushes Alliance territory into the wild mountains.
